verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a first-party importer for migrating data from another tool. The only related items are REST API create/update primitives, which are developer building blocks; integration syncs and embeds, which are adjacent features; and vague marketing ('Bring everything into one system of record'). None of these counts as an import capability for someone switching tools.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can import my data from another tool when switching over
